translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.68:1: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes
verses.68:2: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane
verses.68:3: You will certainly have a never-ending reward
verses.68:4: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character
verses.68:5: Soon you and the pagans will see
verses.68:7: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.68:8: So do not give in to the deniers
verses.68:9: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺
verses.68:10: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker
verses.68:13: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child
verses.68:14: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children
verses.68:15: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”
verses.68:16: We will soon mark his snout
verses.68:17: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning
verses.68:18: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will
verses.68:19: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept
verses.68:20: so it was reduced to ashes
verses.68:21: Then by daybreak they called out to each other
verses.68:22: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”
verses.68:23: So they went off, whispering to one another
verses.68:24: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”
verses.68:25: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose
verses.68:26: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way
verses.68:27: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”
verses.68:28: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”
verses.68:29: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
verses.68:30: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame
verses.68:31: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors
verses.68:32: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”
verses.68:33: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew
verses.68:34: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord
verses.68:35: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked
verses.68:36: What is the matter with you? How do you judge
verses.68:37: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read
verses.68:38: that you will have whatever you choose
verses.68:39: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide
verses.68:40: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that
verses.68:41: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true
verses.68:42: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so
verses.68:43: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺
verses.68:44: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend
verses.68:45: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless
verses.68:46: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
verses.68:47: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺
verses.68:48: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress
verses.68:49: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
verses.68:50: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous
verses.68:51: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”
verses.68:52: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world
